args: Restage only, no release. Validate the achieved post-transfer pose at the actual current frame; the old 3 mm residual target is retired. Identify the same rigid cream-cheese printed face and physical c0/c1 Cream/C short-end corners in that order, using supplied identity references, not stationary projections. Return end_camera/end_pixels. Request p0..p5 as six spread-out depth samples strictly within that printed face, away from seams and fingers; these are plane samples, not correspondences. Do not require hidden corners. Prefer a FRESH bowl opening using the close wrist view: request d0..d3 as spread-out actual horizontal upper-lip surface depths, and eight well-distributed INNER opening rim_pixels with rim_camera. Do not use the sloping interior as the lip plane. If lip depth is unavailable, bowl_mode landmarks may instead request BOTH b0 (large pale floor medallion center) and b1 (separate bottle-side rear inner-wall rosette), independently identified against the supplied baseline. Choose unknown rather than invent measurements. closed_route concerns only one possible 15 mm upward move, at most 12 mm horizontal recentering, and at most 0.32 rad additional tilt about the observed short axis, compensated about the carton center in this NEW workspace. opening_corridor concerns the visible nonrobot surroundings of the current finger envelope plus 20 mm outward on each jaw and a 20 mm upward withdrawal, above the rim; robot self-occlusion alone is not an observed obstacle, but unseen external clearance is not certified. No descent or opening will occur.

end_identity_reference.scope: Physical identity reference only; after movement these pixels are not current measurements.

references.scope: Historical dimensions and physical identities; current face-anchored extent envelopes are not observations of hidden corners. The 0.4 mm floor and propagated uncertainties are conservative operational allowances, not calibrated confidence bounds.

result.explanation: At frame 396, the visible Cream face and its C-end corners support the same rigid carton identity. The opposite end is robot-occluded and is not inferred. The patterned bowl appears unchanged and upright. Fresh face and lip samples are supplied to measure the achieved pose, not to resume the retired residual target. No external obstruction is apparent along the scoped local closed restaging motion. The outward opening envelope is not fully established, particularly beside the visible dark bottle. No release or completion is established.

parameters.notes: c0 is the visible left Cream/C short-end corner; c1 is its right counterpart, in reference identity order. p0..p5 are current interior printed-face plane samples, not historical correspondences. d0..d3 target the narrow upper-lip surface, not the patterned sloping interior. Use only lip-surface depth returns; reject boundary mixing and test horizontal coplanarity. Eight inner opening boundary pixels are supplied separately. If lip returns fail, a landmark fallback has not been independently established here; do not substitute arbitrary rosettes. Regions require surface segmentation, especially local_surroundings; robot pixels are not external obstacles. Closed-route clear is limited to the visible local 15 mm raise, at most 12 mm recentering and at most 0.32 rad center-compensated tilt, not a global clearance certificate. Opening clearance remains unknown rather than obstructed: robot occlusion and unmeasured bottle separation do not demonstrate contact. Compare fresh depths with the baseline before asserting metric pose or retention; closed fingers alone are not retention evidence. No descent or opening is authorized.
